Defense

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +3 Dex, +1 natural armor)

HP 28 (4d8+8)

MP 7

Fort +3, Reflex +8, Will +6

Defensive Abilities Feathers of Gale, Well-Versed; Resist Wind 5;

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Rapier +5 (1d6+2/18-20)

Ranged Shortbow +6 (1d6 x3)

Special Attacks Dissonance (5/day, Base DC 15)

Special Abilities Bardic Performance (13 rounds/day), Countersong, Distraction, Fascinate (DC 15), Inspire Courage +1, Inspire Competence +2, Inspire Greatness, Inspiration (2d6) [6/day], Troubadour (3/day)

Statistics

Feats Lingering Performance, Spellsong

Languages Common, Lalafellan, Undercommon, Yagudo

SQ Minor Aura +3 (Accurate Strike, Watchful Eye), Versatile Performance (Wind), Major Aura +1 (Motivate Ardor)

Gear cure potion (2), rapier, shortbow, 20 arrows, studded leather armor

description.value: Generated feat from the source statblock: Lingering Performance.

Spend one bardic performance round to conceal a bard spell as a swift action: observers oppose the bard's Perform check with Perception or Sense Motive. Alternatively, spend one round as a move action to maintain concentration on a bard spell, allowing another spell to be cast. Use the Bardic Performance pool for both modes.

Published feat rules. Optional reference: pf-content-for-ffd20.pf-feats / KTl9v5s5t42R0IfD.

description.value: Defensive ability listed in the source statblock: Well-Versed.

Though yagudos don't use their beaks for biting an opponent, they will use it if desperate enough to end the combat with their enemy. They all possess a bite natural attack that inflicts 1d4 points of damage on a hit. This is a primary attack, or a secondary attack if the yagudo wields a manufactured weapon.

description.value: Yagudos are very good with talking out their problems, establishing trade and setting up offerings in order to provide a type of peace and learn many different languages in order to keep that peace. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.
Yagudos being of the religious zealots gain a +2 to all Knowledge (Religion) checks and gain an additional +1 per 5 ranks in the skill.
Inspiration

effect: Allies in range, optionally self: gain [[2d6]] temporary HP until lost or battle ends.

description.value: Bardic Performance

effect: Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Countersong for targets and maintenance.
Roll wind performance [[1d20 + @skills.prf.subSkills.wind.mod]] each round; hearing targets may substitute it for qualifying saves against sonic or language-dependent magic.
Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Distraction for targets and maintenance.
Requires visual Perform, not Wind. Roll an eligible untrained Perform check [[1d20 + @abilities.cha.mod]]; use against a qualifying illusion's save.
Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Fascinate for targets and maintenance.
Success grants 24-hour immunity. Obvious threats break fascination.

target.value: up to two creatures who can see and hear the bard

effect: Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Inspire Courage for targets and maintenance.
Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Inspire Competence for targets and maintenance.
One ally's selected skill gains +2 competence; use the named skill on the recipient.
Spend one round from the shared performance pool. See Inspire Greatness for targets and maintenance.
One willing creature in range that sees and hears the bard gains two bonus HD with corresponding temporary HP. Apply Inspire Greatness and roll [[2d10]] plus twice the recipient's Con modifier.
Roll Perform (wind) [[1d20 + @skills.prf.subSkills.wind.mod]] opposed by observers' Perception or Sense Motive to mask casting a bard spell.
Maintain concentration on a bard spell for one round while casting another spell. Spend one shared performance round.
Maintain the same performance for one more round; stop if unable to maintain it.
